arkmodulestaketheirbossdrops.verdict: obsolete (a), already rewritten on main; no change here
arkmodulestaketheirbossdrops.what: It checked the v1 table recipes of the nature, arcane and exploration modules against their boss drops (wet sponge, nether star, dragon breath). Ark v2 (docs/design/ark-modules-v2.md, f038227) made each module the one-time reward of its act's Atlas project and removed the module recipes. The recipe audit replaced the test with ProgressionFullpackGameTests.arkModulesComeOnlyFromTheirActProjects (bf41d8e): each module is the reward of its act's project (I habitation, II exploration, III nature, IV arcane, V logistics and engineering), asks at most one ENTRELUMEN component, no loaded recipe crafts it and the ark_* integration recipes are gone.
arkmodulestaketheirbossdrops.whyItFailed: The Solsticio v8 runs D and E used head e46b619, cut from 27fb170: that base had Ark v2 but not bf41d8e, so its QA JAR still carried the v1 test against the v2 projects. Main has had the rewritten test since the recipe audit merged.
evidence: this batch: PASS in full-pack runs A and B

sunspiritdropstheheartonceanditclosesact.verdict: obsolete fixture (a); rewritten to the Ark v2 act IV
sunspiritdropstheheartonceanditclosesact.what: Ark v2 (f038227) moved the Arcane Module project to act IV and made the Voices of the Atlas wait for it (docs/design/ark-modules-v2.md, "Módulos por acto": IV Arcano, and the closing project of its act waits for it; projects.json: atlas_voices requires arcane_module). The test's act IV fixture predates that: with the Heart in the Atlas the voices still lacked arcane_module, so 'entrelumen deliver atlas_voices' returned 0 and the test reported 'Act IV did not close with the Heart in the Atlas'. Its earlier check that the voices refuse without the Heart also passed for the wrong reason. The isolated twin, fourthActRequiresJourneysAndFiveDeliveries, was updated by Ark v2; this full-pack test was not.
sunspiritdropstheheartonceanditclosesact.change: companion/src/fullpackGameTest/java/dev/entrelumen/ActsFullpackGameTests.java: the fixture also completes arcane_module, and before the Sun Spirit dies the test asserts that only heliodor_heart and atlas_voices are left open in act IV and that the voices wait only for the Heart, so the refusal is the Heart's and a new act IV requirement fails by name. The Sun Spirit drop-once, Heart delivery, act V and Summit assertions are unchanged.
evidence: old fixture against projects.json of e46b619 and of main: after the Heart the voices still wait for [arcane_module]
this batch: PASS in full-pack runs A (14.8 s) and B (3.1 s)

triage.altarsrespectforeignftbchunksclaims: The pit must cross a chunk border: a fixture precondition that depends on the test origin. At this world's origin (-12, 63, 8) the altar stands at x 8 and its 15-block pit spans x 1..15, inside chunk 0; at other origins it straddles a border (run D of Solsticio v8, origin x -8). The failed precondition also leaves its two mock players online, because it runs before the sessions' cleanup. Unrelated to this change; altars.
triage.levellingaltarrepairslandfromthepacksown: DONE skipped=1: the site 48 blocks east of the origin put the repair's four chunks at chunk x 1..2, and chunks (1,0) and (1,1) hold GameTest barriers and floors of earlier tests that share the origin (the claims test's 40-wide template among them), so the altar refused one chunk it could not match to the generator, as designed. Position- and order-dependent; unrelated to this change; altars.
triage.thesealedstairstandsunderthestartruin: The antechamber is not protected: startruinisanchoredregisteredandplacedonce ran earlier in the same server and places a second start ruin 4096 blocks east into a throwaway RuinData, but HeliodorRuins.place always calls EnvesEntrance.onStartRuinPlaced, which re-recorded the world's Sealed Stair there (log 02:12:10, heart 4084, 62, 8). That ruin is not in the world's RuinData, so StructureProtection does not guard its antechamber. Order-dependent: in the Envés batch QA (enves-20260926/qa-A-8eafac9.json) the sealed stair ran first and both passed. A test-isolation defect since the Envés engine; in play only one start ruin is placed. Unrelated to this change; Envés and ruins.
